bugs.issue: Burger menu visible at 1440px when it should be hidden
bugs.rootCause: site.css line 297 declares `display: none` but line 304 overrides with `display: flex` in the same .header-hamburger block (cascade order). The media query `@media (max-width: 768px)` on line 327-330 hides it on mobile, but no query hides it above 1024px. The `@media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px)` on line 321-325 only sets `display: flex` redundantly — outside this range, the default `display: flex` from line 304 remains active.
bugs.fix: Remove `display: flex` from the .header-hamburger base block (line 304). Move it only into the `@media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px)` block. Add `display: none` as the default (line 297 is correct but overridden). Add `@media (min-width: 1025px) { .header-hamburger { display: none; } }`

recommendation.summary: Site is functional but has critical navigation bugs at certain breakpoints. The main issues are: (1) burger menu visible at desktop widths, (2) whitepaper mobile nav completely empty, (3) presentation page missing key JS, (4) horizontal scroll on mobile home page. Recommend fixing all critical items before deployment.
